query: INSERT INTO meta_messaging_revision (connection_id,customer_id,provider_message_id,direction,content,edit_number,edited_at,deleted_at) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8) ON CONFLICT (connection_id,customer_id,provider_message_id) DO UPDATE SET content=EXCLUDED.content,edit_number=GREATEST(meta_messaging_revision.edit_number,EXCLUDED.edit_number),edited_at=EXCLUDED.edited_at,deleted_at=EXCLUDED.deleted_at WHERE meta_messaging_revision.deleted_at IS NULL AND (EXCLUDED.deleted_at IS NOT NULL OR EXCLUDED.edit_number>meta_messaging_revision.edit_number)
